## Details

<a id="score_add_kill"></a>
### [`score_add_kill`](../../../../src/game/score_add.asm#L6) `$5E10`

*routine*

Adds the kill points $aa to the last score digit $16 and carries the digits $16-$13 into the next digit. Then it doubles $aa. The wave start sets $aa to 25, so the kills give 25, 50, 100 and 200. The digit $12 has no carry test.

- **Called from:** [`enemy_kill`](../enemy/enemy_kill.md#enemy_kill)
- **Reads:** [`kill_points`](../../memory-map.md#kill_points), [`score`](../../memory-map.md#score), [`radar_offset`](../../memory-map.md#radar_offset)
- **Writes:** [`score`](../../memory-map.md#score), [`radar_offset`](../../memory-map.md#radar_offset), [`kill_points`](../../memory-map.md#kill_points)
